content.short: Daimo routes deposits from any currency, chain or app into the stablecoin an application wants.
content.description: Daimo routes funds from any currency, chain or app into the stablecoin a receiving application wants, aimed at raising deposit conversion. Integrators choose between a pre-built React deposit UI through the SDK, which handles chain selection, wallet connection and signing in around thirty lines of code, and a plain REST API for custom flows. The SDK supports both embedded and overlay presentation. One supported route deposits straight into Hyperliquid.
